description: This file defines the ResourceServer class for OAuth2 middleware in SuiteCRM, handling request validation, user authentication, and error handling for OAuth2 protected resources.

classes.name: ResourceServer
classes.description: Middleware class for handling OAuth2 protected resource requests by validating tokens and setting current user context.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ResourceServer with an OAuthResourceServer instance.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Main middleware method that validates the incoming request unless the route is exempt, and handles exceptions.

methods.name: setCurrentUserGlobal
methods.description: Sets the global current_user variable based on the authenticated OAuth user, throws exception if user is inactive.

methods.name: getUserFromRequest
methods.description: Retrieves the user associated with the OAuth token, or fallback to client-assigned user, throws if no active user found.
